component.name: Apklayer
component.summary: Run Android apps on Linux in Wayland windows

description.p: apklayer runs Android apps (APKs) as Linux processes, each in its own Wayland window. The manager installs, opens and manages them; its first run downloads the Android runtime bundle.
The host needs the binder kernel driver with binderfs mounted at /dev/binderfs (a one-time root step the manager names).
